about_the_game:
Join the Discord to keep up-to-date with playtests!

Features

  • Genre-bending combat system, featuring a mix of highly mechanical shooter and melee gameplay

  • Class-based gameplay. Adventure with a fixed class of 64 students with up to 7 friends for a multi-day adventure into the Tower

  • High-intensity Souls-like boss fights

Story

Current Time - 300 years

The mysterious Tower was discovered during maritime expeditions. Early attempts to explore its depths proved perilous, as none of the initial human ventures returned. This failure only deepened the Tower’s enigmatic reputation, sparking legends of hidden wonders and unseen dangers that continue to captivate the human imagination.

Current Time - 50 years

With the rise of advanced artificial intelligence, a bold initiative was undertaken: AI-operated robots were dispatched into the Tower to uncover its secrets and relay vital information. Unfortunately, the mission did not yield the desired insights and ultimately failed, leaving many questions unanswered.

Current Time

In the present day, breakthroughs in quantum entanglement have revolutionized communication, leading to the creation of the Akasha System. This innovative system enables humans to remotely pilot the SSFrame into the Tower—while being accompanied by an AI android that provides support and guidance throughout the mission. As explorers delve deeper, they have uncovered extraordinary resources, such as plants capable of extending human lifespans and seemingly infinite energy sources. These groundbreaking discoveries spurred the founding of the Tower Delver Association, an organization dedicated to extracting these precious assets and unraveling the enduring mysteries of the Tower.

Welcome Recruit

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K | Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X | AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 480, 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A limited-time multiplayer experience featuring Roguelite PvPvE and a unique "2nd person" combat system
